selected_skill.purpose: Use a compact video pickup workflow for repeatable source-image extraction through the shipped pickup helper, then build the rest of the delivery bundle around those picks.

skillsmp_references.name: video-frames
skillsmp_references.relevance: Direct match for the repeated locator-driven pickup steps.

skillsmp_references.name: gifgrep
skillsmp_references.relevance: Adjacent clip inspection workflow with contact-sheet style review outputs.

skillsmp_references.name: songsee
skillsmp_references.relevance: Adjacent media inspection workflow built around compact visual extraction.

skillsmp_references.name: video-editing
skillsmp_references.relevance: Broader media pipeline skill that overlaps with clip trimming and review delivery.

environment_design.determinism: The task uses mirrored input clips plus fixed request tables and layout rules. Verifier-side oracles regenerate expected stills and compare output media content instead of trusting filenames alone.
anti_toy_features: three public-source video clips with different frame rates, durations, and dimensions
helper-authored locator fragments, including empty locator rows that still require valid source-image delivery through the staged pickup helper
the pickup path is intentionally bound to an approved helper command, so agents must verify availability before bulk export instead of inventing an alternate route
per-request preview clips in addition to stills
per-clip contact sheets that must reflect the requested ordering and native cell sizes
structured delivery metadata that must match the generated files

main_tests: request coverage across all stills, previews, and sheets
pixel-level still validation against regenerated oracle frames using the same pickup semantics as the staged helper
preview duration and frame-content validation against source clips
frame index and delivery report cross-consistency
guardrails: input files under /root/media_pick/input must remain unchanged
the shipped media input area must remain unchanged
top-level output inventory must match the contract
placeholder or verifier-oriented text in JSON outputs fails

expected_skill_effect.without_skill: Without the shipped pickup helper, agents are more likely to spend time searching for an approved route and then either stop on the blocker or drift into an unapproved fallback path.
expected_skill_effect.with_skill: The skill gives the agent an immediate, repeatable path for resolving locator fragments into exact source-image picks through the staged pickup helper, so the delivery bundle can be completed without detouring into helper discovery.
